lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod1: Win a <font color='#00b034'>match</font> against another player in the<font color='#00b034'> Arena </font>.
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod2:
Go to the outer zone map and defeat a number of monsters.
The monster list of the outer zone map is at the top of the interface, and you can choose Attack/Combo.
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod3:
Go to the outer zone map and defeat a number of monsters to obtain items.
The monster list of the outer zone map is at the top of the interface, and you can choose Attack/Combo.
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod4: Go to the indicated map and talk to the target NPC.
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod5: Defeat the <font color='#00b034'>BOSS</font> on the outer zone map for a chance to get Demon Head, Demon Blood, Demon Heart and Demon Soulstone.
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod6:
Defeat a random BOSS on the target map for a chance to get a Nation Name card. You can also buy it at the Market.
Fire Village : Smelting Mountains, Eventide Barrens, Fiery Ridge
Water Village : Verdant Alley, Slowflower River, Greenwaves Plain
Earth Village : Hidden Dragon Corridor, Boulder Cavern, Lush Altar
Wind Village : Windscent Pass, Ashvoid Gully, Typhoon Plateau
Lightning Village : Peaked Whetstone, Thundering Steps, Holywood Range
An Anonymous Namecard can be obtained by synthesizing three Anonymous Namecards (from exploring)
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod7:
Iron Ore can be obtained through quick synthesis.
Formula:
Iron Ore=Weapon+Weapon Disassembly Scroll (can be bought at the Item Shop)+Weapon Disassembly Scroll
Iron Ore==Weapon+Weapon Disassembly Scroll (can be bought at the Item Shop)+Weapon Disassembly Scroll
Iron Ore==Weapon+Weapon Disassembly Scroll (can be bought at the Item Shop)+Weapon Disassembly Scroll
Armor pieces include Helmet, Chest Armor, Leg Armor, Gloves and Belt.
Accessories include rings and necklaces.
lg_Common_DailyTaskMethod8:
Rare Iron Ore can only be obtained through quick synthesis in your bag.
Synthesis formula:
Rare Iron Ore=Weapon+Mysterious Weapon Disassembly Scroll (bought at the Black Market shop)+Hand Grenade (obtained from exploring and the slot machine)
Rare Iron=Weapon+Mysterious Weapon Disassembly Scroll (bought at the Black Market shop)+Hand Grenade (obtained from exploring and the slot machine)
Rare Iron=Accessory+Mysterious Weapon Disassembly Scroll (bought at the Black Market shop)+Hand Grenade (obtained from exploring and the slot machine)
Armor pieces include Helmet, Chest Armor, Leg Armor, Gloves and Belt.
Accessories include rings and necklaces.
Mysterious Weapon Disassembly Scrolls are classified into weapon, armor and accessory.

lg_Common_PetRoomHelpInfo:
Pet Development Tips:

1. Feed your pet the specific food types listed in the menu.
2. If adjacent slots have the same food type, you get a hunger reduction bonus:
2 slots: 5%
3: 15%
4: 30%
5: 50%
6: 70%
If 6 slots have different food types , you get a 40% bonus.
A pet's favorite food increases its fullness by 2%
3. Pet food can be obtained from the grocery, outdoor exploration, daily quests and the item mall;
4. When a pet is full, it may discover one of several skills. Each discovery guarantees that it can learn more skills
5. If all skill slots are filled, one old skill will be replaced at random ;
6. Click a skill icon to lock it so it cannot be replaced; this needs one Skill Lock. Every lock needs a Skill Lock. Skill Lock can be bought in the mall with gold or gift coupons.

lg_Common_TollGateTips0: <font color='#00ffff'>Since a time unknown to all, traitor ninjas have been fleeing in droves to the Demon City. These corrupt ninjas from the darkness have built their own stronghold in Valhalla, and your help is needed to destroy their base.</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips1: <font color='#00ffff'>The only road to Valhalla is blockaded by the demon army, whose resources come from the demons. Anyone who wants to enter Valhalla must break the sealed layers here.</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips2: <font color='#00ffff'>A sea of green that once served as Valhalla's natural defensive buffer is now overrun with demons. The three brave warriors, the pig, the deer and the butterfly, have also been imprisoned here by the demons' rule. They are waiting for you to rescue them!</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips3: <font color='#00ffff'>The final stretch between the ninja army and the demon soldiers. The Bloodgrass scattered across the land gets its color from the blood spilled by both sides. A group of Younglings holds off the demons here.</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips4: <font color='#00ffff'>The holiday village of the ancient Deadwood royalty. A group of young female disciples who have been bound to this village since long ago try to defend it against the demons.</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips5: <font color='#00ffff'>When night falls, the fallen warriors who were once taken over by the evil demons of Valhalla awaken. The only way for them to repent is to defeat them!</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips6: <font color='#00ffff'>Skilled in wind ninjutsu, brave warriors defended the village they loved so much alongside Temari and Gaara, but in the end they fell to the demons too. They are now imprisoned in the Sandwind Hall, and you can rescue them with magic tricks!</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips7: <font color='#00ffff'>This is a vast forest with thick fog, and no one has ever come out of it. Can you change history and make it through this forest?</font>
lg_Common_TollGateTips8: <font color='#00ffff'>Nobody expected to see Sosuke Aizen here. He even uses Kyoka Suigetsu to test the abilities of the intruders. Since all the opponents who enter are strong, a fierce battle is coming.</font>

1. Drag an <font color='#00b034'>outfit +0</font> or <font color='#00b034'>pet +0</font> from your bag into the box.

lg_CountMark_Brief:
1. Weapons and armor can be inscribed. The highest inscription level is 12. 
2. Inscription can improve basic attributes: minimum and maximum weapon attack and armor defense.
3. Inscription requires Inscription Talismans and Stone. Up to 3 Inscription Talismans can be used. (If the chance exceeds 100%, the system will automatically reduce the number)
4. The level increases after a successful inscription. If inscription fails, click the inscription description to check the level.
lg_CountMark_Des:
1. Move a weapon or armor from your bag into the box.
2. Choose the type of Inscription Talisman. You can use 3 Inscription Talismans. High Level Inscription Talismans have a higher success rate. Low Level Inscription Talismans can be obtained from training, quest rewards and slot machine challenges.
3. The highest inscription level is 12. It raises the base attributes of equipment and weapons: Min and Max on weapons, and defense on armor.
4. The inscription level increases by 1 on success.
5. <font color='#ff0000'>If inscription fails, the inscription level will not drop at or below level 4 (including level 4). It will drop to level 4 if it fails at levels 5, 6 and 7. And it will drop to level 8 if it fails at levels 8, 9, 10 and 11. </font>

Killing monsters gives EXP as a reward. Visit the Chief to get items as a reward.
Normal ore usually gives Stones. Rare ore can also give Stones.
Proof of Courage gives items as a reward. Collecting Namecards gives Outfits as a reward.
Collecting Foreign Matter gives equipment and items as rewards.

2. The item slots will open after slot creation.
3. The number of slots cannot exceed the slots available in the equipment.
4. Items without slots cannot have slots created.

lg_ExtendFriend_Help3:
Referral procedure：
1. Click “I want to recommend” to generate your own link
2. Clickcopy information to recommendto copy that information and link so you can send it to your friends.
3. Other players can use thelink registration featureandcreate a characterin the game，thenwatch the battle videoand accept 1 quests，and the referral will succeed

Reward description：
1. When you and the person you recommended have reached level 20，30，40，50，60 , both of you will get rewards.
2. Find Referrer Reward and click Claim to get EXP and gift coupons .
3. The recommended person can go to“Reward for recommended person” and click Claim to getEXP and item rewards.

Special Notice：
1. If the Recommended person does not log in within15days, the system will remove that player from the Recommended list, and the player's contribution will not count toward your rewards.
2. Each month, you can only claim rewards for up to 30 recommended players，rewards from other recommended players will not be counted.
3. Each player can claim the reward after meeting the specified requirements.
lg_ExtendFriend_Help4:
Gift coupon reward：
1. All gold spent by applicants is counted in real time.
2. 10% of the gold spent by the applicant will be sent to you in the form of gift coupons.
3. Gift coupons below1 cannot be claimed until they have accumulated to 1.
4. If you do not claim your gift coupons, you can claim them later
5. Once the applicant has a relationship with you, the gold they spend will no longer count toward your reward.

lg_FailDialog_100: Ha, have you reached your limit already? You can't satisfy my thirst for battle in the end!
lg_FailDialog_120: Damn insect, I won't spare you!
lg_FailDialog_130: Forgive me, Lord Sosuke Aizen, it seems I cannot repay my debt!
lg_FailDialog_140: Is there no such thing as victory without sacrifice?
lg_FailDialog_150: The real battle lies ahead, so don't be too anxious. I'll take my leave now, farewell!
lg_FailDialog_151: Great strength plus fine skill techniques, hmm, quite impressive. But can you go far against his madness?
lg_FailDialog_152: You cannot defeat my madness. Bloodthirsty man, I'll be counting you.
lg_FailDialog_153: My persistence cannot compare with speed. But that will change when you cannot use speed.
lg_FailDialog_154: You are truly a tough one. I will stay still. Now, prepare for the coming storm.
lg_FailDialog_155: Amazing, a human who can turn back the forces of nature. You truly deserve to challenge him.
lg_FailDialog_156: There is no best spear without a better shield. The battle between you and him will be very interesting.
lg_FailDialog_157: Is war without violence the ideal world? Is fighting only against despair merely practice?
lg_FailDialog_158: I'm still lost even after deciding to risk my life! But he will teach you a lesson.
lg_FailDialog_159: The best defense is a good offense, which is always right. Even if you hit me, you will learn true fear
lg_FailDialog_160: I must admit you are a true hero. Here, you can take the EXP and leave right away. How dare you break my fashion glasses, damn it!
lg_FailDialog_161: Even if I become a part of your body, I will get you someday!
lg_FailDialog_162: No wonder you could defeat me. Such power at such a young age is truly admirable!
lg_FailDialog_163: I can't win even though I have five hearts?
lg_FailDialog_164: …………You ruined my ritual! You will be punished!!
lg_FailDialog_165: You will never understand the meaning of my art!
lg_FailDialog_166: If you can stop Nagato, why should I stop him?
lg_FailDialog_167: Maybe you can stop Sasuke Uchiha!
lg_FailDialog_168: I can't believe Samehada matches your chakra!
lg_FailDialog_169: As it happens, I have to trust you!
lg_FailDialog_170: You and I are far apart, even though you have a slim chance of defeating me!
lg_FailDialog_20: Hoho, not too bad, but you still have a long way to go!
lg_FailDialog_30: This is only the beginning, I will come back to kill you, don't get too arrogant!
lg_FailDialog_40: I live only to fight, I can still fight! I won't lose!
lg_FailDialog_50: Damn, why did it turn out like this?! Too bad, it seems you won't leave the monastery alive!
lg_FailDialog_60: To think there was someone whose madness surpassed mine...
lg_FailDialog_70: So this is what despair feels like...
lg_FailDialog_80: You are indeed strong! But if that is all the great power you have, then you are no match for me!
lg_FailDialog_90: To think you made it this far, I will give you real despair!

lg_FinishSay_n81001: I'm glad you're willing to share your barbecue flavored potato chips with me!
lg_FinishSay_n81002: Do you have barbecue flavored potato chips? Awesome! Want to share some with me?
lg_FinishSay_n81003: Are you carrying an ANBU Mask?
lg_FinishSay_n81004: I'm tired of wearing glasses every day and want to change my style. The ANBU look amazing in their masks. Do you dare to bring me one of their masks?
lg_FinishSay_n81005: I'm not a man of many words, but I have to admit your IQ is as high as 200.
lg_FinishSay_n81006: Shogi can help sharpen your mind. And it's a great way to spend this afternoon.
lg_FinishSay_n81007: As a member of the Hyuga Clan, I must help my younger sibling retrieve the family crest. But I can't do this alone. Can you help me with it?
lg_FinishSay_n81008: It's good to see you here. Can you give it to me, so I can prove that the branch house never loses to the main house!
lg_FinishSay_n81009: Great! Now that you have delivered the secret letter to Tsunade, our village will go on the defensive soon.
lg_FinishSay_n81010: You delivered the letter to Asuma? Awesome! What a relief.
lg_FinishSay_n81011: Sasuke is so charming and adorable! I heard Sasuke has fallen ill. If only I were by his side!
lg_FinishSay_n81012: Where am I? Who is this? You saved me... I didn't know you carried a medical bag. So, I'll thank you for it!!
lg_FinishSay_n81013: Pain is incredibly strong. I can't heal everyone with my own medical bag alone. I hope I can get more bags from somewhere.
lg_FinishSay_n81014: To ease my anxiety, I can use puppet items to make Father and Mother. Puppet items can be used over and over, so I don't have to worry about where to find them.
lg_FinishSay_n81015: Great! Is this your Kankuro puppet or that one? Never mind. It's mine once you give it to me.
lg_FinishSay_n81016: Puppet items are quite valuable. There's no need to worry about funds if we can get more.
lg_FinishSay_n81017: To protect what I love, I must become strong! I need more Kunai for my training!
lg_FinishSay_n81018: We'll run out of Kunai soon. Where can we get them?
lg_FinishSay_n81019: I heard the villages need Kunai in large amounts, but I don't have many left.
lg_FinishSay_n81020: For the safety of the village, we need a lot of Exploding Tags. But the number of tags needed now is beyond my ability.
lg_FinishSay_n81021: For the safety of the village, we need a lot of Exploding Tags. But the number of tags needed now is beyond my ability.
lg_FinishSay_n81022: For the safety of the village, we need a lot of Exploding Tags. But the number of tags needed now is beyond my ability.
lg_FinishSay_n81023: Money! Money! Hahaha! OMG, I must be dreaming!
lg_FinishSay_n81024: I'm worried about death. How can I raise funds in such a short time?
lg_FinishSay_n81025: This is not an easy task. It seems that group is about to make a big move with that much money.
lg_FinishSay_n81026: Water Plains is a peaceful place. People can collect free landscape paintings in their spare time.
lg_FinishSay_n81027: Painting is not only a fighting style, it is also a way to purify the mind. Collecting these landscape paintings is my hobby.
lg_FinishSay_n81028: If it weren't for that war, I could also live freely and make a few paintings.
lg_FinishSay_n81029: The village has suffered great losses! Now I feel tired because we have shortened the reconstruction time. I've almost eaten all the Supply Pills.
lg_FinishSay_n81030: Today's goal is to run backwards for 500 laps! I need Supply Pills!
lg_FinishSay_n81031: I'm going out to fight like last time
lg_FinishSay_n81032: To help Sasuke and the others, I must restore the supply pills for later needs.
lg_FinishSay_n81033: For weapons, you must use a scroll first. Even the Sharingan cannot copy the writing on a Weapon Channeling Scroll. That is why Weapon Channeling Scrolls are vital for the safety of the village.
lg_FinishSay_n81034: Get some Weapon Channeling Scrolls for Sasuke. It will help him a lot.
lg_FinishSay_n81035: It is said that a Scroll of Seals can seal people inside it. I really want to get one.
lg_FinishSay_n81036: I want to release everything sealed in the scroll to kill that person.
lg_FinishSay_n81037: Orochimaru's Juinjutsu can greatly improve one's abilities. So it's worth trying to leave Konoha.
lg_FinishSay_n81038: Experiments are barely enough for someone to develop a new Juinjutsu. The best way is to seek out a new Juinjutsu.
lg_FinishSay_n81039: The power to destroy an entire country in an instant and the pain it causes the world feel very important to make people refrain from war.
lg_FinishSay_n81040: Try sneaking into every village in every country to see the secret letters about the Jinchūriki. This way, you can understand the Jinchūriki faster than the Akatsuki.
lg_FinishSay_n81041: Awww... the others lost! I can't pay my debts. What should I do? Every country is collecting Mysterious Weapon Bags. Maybe I should send Jiraiya to get some so I can sell them at a good price...
lg_FinishSay_n81042: The villagers need some Mysterious Weapon Bags so they can protect themselves while I'm away. But it's possible for me to find the bags alone.
lg_FinishSay_n81043: I have already learned Sage Mode from the Toad Sage at Mount Myoboku. But learning how the Toad Sage's contracts and channeling work is more important...
lg_FinishSay_n81044: I want to record more channeling skills in my scroll so that no one can learn them in secret.

lg_HomeBuild_Help_0000:
Tips for building your home:

1. Click a building in the building list to begin

2. A building's lock will open automatically once the requirements are met

3. Some buildings can have 2 or more

4. A building's level cannot exceed your home's level

5. The garden and the windmill are not only decorations, they also bring you abundant resources;

6. Click the edit button in the top right corner to edit. You can change the location of buildings in edit mode;

7. Besides buildings, you can also use decorations and scenery to fill your home with love.
lg_HomeBuild_Help_1002:
Wall message tips :

1. You can check what other players have done at your home through wall messages;

2. Use Delete Message to delete a specific message, and delete all messages in the same category by using Delete List.
lg_HomeBuild_Help_1003:
Quest board tips :

1. You can offer some gold as a reward to recruit other players to help you complete a quest;

2. A certain amount of Stone is required to publish a quest;

3. If you are strong enough, you can accept other players' quests to earn rewards;

4. A certain amount of tax will be deducted from the reward when you complete another player's quest;

5. The number of your quests that can be published and the reward tax depend on the level of the quest board;

Quest Board Level Publishable Quests Accepted Quests Tax Rate
Lv1 5 2 30%
Lv2 6 3 20%
Lv3 7 4 15%
Lv4 8 5 10%
Lv5 10 6 5%
lg_HomeBuild_Help_1006:
Warehouse tips:

1. The warehouse can be used to store farm produce and eggs.

2. The warehouse only has 2 initial slots. You can unlock other slots to get more space.

3. Visitor capacity and crop capacity by warehouse level:

Lv1: Can unlock 2 slots, harvest capacity 1500.
Lv2： Lv2: Can unlock 4 slots, harvest capacity 2000.
Lv3： Can unlock 8 slots, harvest capacity 2500.
Lv4: Can unlock 16 slots, harvest 3000.
Lv5： Can unlock 30 slots, harvest capacity 3500.
lg_HomeBuild_Help_1007:
Pet raising tips :

1. You must feed your pet the type of food it needs, as listed in the menu;

2. If the same type of crop is placed in adjacent slots, you will get a fullness bonus:
2 slots: 5%
3 slots: 15%
4 slots: 30%
5 slots: 50%
6 slots: 70%
If you have 6 different food slots, you will still get a 40% bonus.
Each of your pet's favorite foods will earn a 2% fullness bonus;

3. Pet food can be obtained from Pet History, exploration, daily quests and the item mall;

4. When the pet is full, you can choose one of three skills to take and learn 1 skill;

5. If the skill slots are full, an old skill will be erased at random;

6. Click a skill icon to lock it so it won't be replaced, but it will cost one skill lock. Each skill costs a skill lock to lock, which can be purchased with Gold or Gift Coupon in the Item Mall.
lg_HomeBuild_Help_1008:
Guidance Room tips:

1. When you reach Novice III in the arena and defeat an enemy whose level is above 18, you can take that player as your disciple in the Guidance Room.

2. If a player is already a teacher or a disciple, you cannot become a teacher.

3. Teaching or punishing a disciple will give you bonus EXP.

4. You will get bonus EXP from your disciple every 15 minutes. You will receive the EXP when the player stops being your disciple

5. If you are a disciple or a teacher, you will get bonus EXP from every act of help toward your disciple or teacher.

6. You can challenge your teacher or end your discipleship if you do not like your teacher.

7. You can only fight your teacher once a day.

lg_LT_Rule:
Event Time:
Death Challenge: From 18:00-23:00 every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
Endurance Challenge: From 9:00-23:50 every Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday.
Conditions: Meet the required level and pay the entry fee. A player who announces a challenge can receive a bonus equal to 50% of the entry fee.
Reward Settings: The final winner of the Death Challenge can get all the rewards in the jackpot, and the winner of each Endurance Challenge can claim a reward equal to 50% of the entry fee. Rewards can accumulate. The final winner can also take all the rewards from the jackpot.
Special: The rewards in the package are random.
Death Challenge: If a player who holds the challenge manages to survive for half an hour, this player will become the winner of the challenge.
When the host is offline, rewards can also be claimed using the claim reward button (not accumulative).

lg_LevelGuide_1301: Spend some honor or gold for a chance to draw mystery prizes from jars at the Jar Shop! Want a unique Costume? Open jars and try your luck!

lg_LevelGuide_1303: Challenges at the Valhalla level on the Demon City map can be done with friends. Good EXP and powerful Ninja items await you! Even bigger rewards are waiting if you are listed in the rankings!
lg_LevelGuide_1304: Sosuke Aizen and the Arrancar roam 150 floors of Las Noches in Demon City! Every floor taken gives a large EXP reward! Which floor will you climb ?
lg_LevelGuide_1305: There is no victory without hardship! Every village quest reward you complete will make you stronger! You can only complete 20 daily quest rewards, so take your chance to get them!
lg_LevelGuide_1306: Choose an outer map suitable for your level to explore! Exploring triggers random events, such as catching pets, obtaining items, monster encounters, gem looting, etc. To get a chance at an outer boss challenge, you must obtain the Proof of Suppression in the exploration zone!
lg_LevelGuide_1307: Strong ninja can have disciples through battle! You can get disciples to train pets or manage other tasks. This leaves you with more time to train yourself!

If you are not strong enough, you can also try it to gauge the depth of your abilities. You can also place a small bet to predict match results - winners get a small amount of money!

lg_LevelGuide_1311: Auto training in the Hall of a village or Angel City. This guarantees big EXP even when you are offline!
lg_LevelGuide_1312: Form a group and take on challenges on the outer map to obtain rare items and even gold equipment!

1. Stats depend on your status during registration! So please equip your strongest items and set up your most tactical skills before registering!

4. Every World Cup registrant can earn Honor with each win!

lg_MonthSighIn_Rule:
1. Complete one of the following to sign in: 5 arena challenges, 5 Slot Machine plays, or defeating boss monsters 3 times. 
2. You will get 100 points after signing in. Points can be used to redeem rewards.
3. Rewards are divided into Popularity and Normal. Normal rewards can be redeemed at any time.
4. Popularity rewards can be redeemed at 12:00 and 20:00 every day, lasting 30 minutes. There are 2 limited rewards that can only be claimed once every 30 seconds.
5. After all Popularity rewards have been redeemed, the reward will appear immediately.
6. A higher popularity index means a higher chance of getting your ideal reward.
7. There are 3 chances each day to pump Popularity and raise the popularity of your favorite item.
8. <font color='#ff0000'>Your points will be reset at 24:00 on the last day of each calendar month.</font>
9. Players who complete the 28-day sign-in event will win the title King of Login (Attributes: Dodge+38 Critical Strike+35  Armor Break+54  Block+38  valid for 2 weeks). Rewards will be sent to your gift box within 5 working days at the end of this month.

lg_MyNote_OutLineBonus:
Return Benefits:
If a player is below Lv.15 and has been inactive for 3 days or more, the player will get EXP when they log in again.

Tips:
1. The EXP reward is based on the player's level and number of offline days. Players with a higher level and a longer offline time will get a better EXP reward.
2. EXP will stack up to day 30 , meaning a player who was offline for 30 days or more is treated the same as one who was offline for 30 days.
3. Return benefits can be claimed after logging in again.

lg_Note_EquipEnchant_10001:
Refine:
1. Drag an item or equipment from your bag into the refine view.
2. The equipment's level does not change after refining; its attributes are generated and rated again.
3. White equipment items cannot be refined.
lg_Note_EquipEnchant_10002:
Slot Creation:
1. Drag an equipment item from your bag into the slot creation view to create a slot.
2. The item or equipment will gain an extra slot once created.
3. The number of slots cannot exceed the maximum number of slots the item has.
4. Items or equipment that have no slots cannot have extra slots created.
lg_Note_EquipEnchant_10003:
Removal:
1. Drag an item or equipment from your bag into the removal view to remove its crystals.
2. The crystals on the item or equipment will be lost once confirmed.
3. Equipment or items without crystals cannot use the removal function.
lg_Note_EquipEnchant_10004:
Unbind Place :
Drag an item or equipment from your bag into the unbind center view to unbind it.
Unbinding lets a bound item return to its unbound state.
Unbound items cannot be unbound.

lg_Recast_Brief:
1. Use a Recast Talisman or gold to recast your costume
2. The costume's level and number stay unchanged after recasting, but values such as Strength, Agility and Stamina will be regenerated. If you put the costume on the trade market or use costume transfer, the recast value will be lost;
3. The costume skill will increase by 1 level(s) for every 2 stat increases until the max
4. The costume skill will increase by 2 level(s) when 3 stats are maxed.

lg_Say_n11001: The Sakura Plains lie shrouded in darkness. Only the strongest ninja can survive this tough challenge.
lg_Say_n11002: To prove your own Strength, go to the arena, even with a few wounds. You will find a real fight there.
lg_Say_n11003: Mythical artifacts of war are forged in this furnace! If you can dream it, I can make it!
lg_Say_n11004: Need gems to make your equipment more beautiful? Need hidden weapons to improve your combat ability? Or food and potions? We have them all.
lg_Say_n11005: Don't miss our collection of weapons and armor. A variety of equipment is available at the best prices.
lg_Say_n11006: Powerful ninja can use other ninja's services free of charge! Want to take on a disciple? You've come to the right person!
lg_Say_n11012: Pets are your most reliable companions in battle. To let them grow stronger, leave them in the pet stable. Only there will they receive the best care!
lg_Say_n11013: It's no good to stay on standby all the time. Take a look when you're free, you may find some interesting jobs to choose from!
lg_Say_n11014: You can buy high-grade equipment with attributes here using Stone. Want to try your luck?
lg_Say_n11017: It is said the Five Kage are holding a meeting right after the tailed beast raid. Do you want to take a look?
lg_Say_n16007: Want to try your luck? This may be your lucky day!
lg_Say_n17001: The spirits of ancient heroes are under the rule of demons. Can you defeat the servants and the emperor to save the manipulated heroic spirits?
lg_Say_n17003:
Las Noches has powerful opponents. Only the capable and brave can enter. You can sharpen your skills inside. I can take you there, but you must pay for my guide service so that I can clear the way for you.
Another word of advice: The lower the floor, the greater the reward.

Note! Las Noches is affected by Jadebreaker; all EXP buff effects are ineffective there!

lg_Say_n26001: To be an excellent ninja, you need strong martial arts, discipline and teamwork to complete missions perfectly.
lg_Say_n26002: Angel City is a peaceful place - a blessing in itself.
lg_Say_n26003: The rare edible ingredients that grow on the plains are nature's gift to humankind. They must not be trampled carelessly.
lg_Say_n26004: To portray world events through artistic expression is our way of life.
lg_Say_n26005: Croakk! Don't underestimate our toads. Only the talented can fight alongside us.
lg_Say_n26006: Choosing materials is an important task. A wrong decision can lead to terrible consequences.
lg_Say_n26007: Stay alert, and don't leave any suspicious entity unchecked.
lg_Say_n26008: A terrifying dark aura covers the whole land. We must destroy its source.
lg_Say_n26009: If monsters and humans could live in harmony, the world would be a much better place.
lg_Say_n26010: Those residents of Angel City get on my nerves. I must teach them a lesson if I ever get the chance.
lg_Say_n26011: With the presence of demons, herb gathering in the area has been whittled down to almost nothing. We won't have enough medicine to treat people at this rate.
lg_Say_n26012: Only through hard training can one become stronger.
lg_Say_n26013:
Child, you can use rings of different quality to redeem a Lover Ring into a high-level appraised one here. After that, the number of ring attributes will be the same, but the type and effect of the attributes will be better!
But please note that the ring's enchantment attributes and embedded gems will be removed!

lg_Say_n26800: Check the previous ranks. For the honor of the 'Kage'!
lg_Say_n26900: Tailed beasts are attacking our village. Hurry! We must rally all our forces and defend our village!
lg_Say_n27001: It's Christmas. Have you had any Mooncake?
lg_Say_n27002: I swear I will make the best Mooncake――Shippuden Mooncake!
lg_Say_n27100: Welcome to the Stone Organization. Here you can find the ideal team and quickly restore HP and Chakra

lg_Say_n28001: You're lucky to find me here. I have some valuable items, so hurry and pick a few.
lg_Say_n28002: I was the first to enter the mystic Dragontame Valley. What would you like to know?
lg_Say_n28003: Explorers came to Dragontame Valley, boasting that they were the first. So we had to hide here.
lg_Say_n28004: Ninja from all the villages have gathered at the Dragontame Coast. It feels like something is about to happen.
lg_Say_n28005: Every drop of rain is linked to Pain's ninjutsu. He can tell where you are as soon as you touch the rain!
lg_Say_n28100: Welcome to the Stone Organization. Here you can find the ideal team and quickly restore HP and Chakra
lg_Say_n28200: Welcome to the Stone Organization. Here you can find the ideal team and quickly restore HP and Chakra
lg_Say_n29001: Want to build a cool village? You should learn from me!
lg_Say_n81002: Although staying slim is my goal, I still want to eat barbecue chips. I wonder if Choji has a lot.
lg_Say_n81003: I'm curious why people wear ANBU masks all the time. Could you try to give me one of the ANBU masks?
lg_Say_n81004: Never underestimate an opponent, no matter how small they may seem... Always give your best punch!
lg_Say_n81005: You know I don't want to make myself into a pickle. What do you want? Shogi or cloud watching?
lg_Say_n81006: It's the usual practice to play shogi with Shikamaru. I have to beat him...
lg_Say_n81007: Everyone lives within inevitable trends... people only share one common fate... Death
lg_Say_n81008: Why are we a branch family while they belong to the main family? I must get a badge to prove my abilities! I'm not sure how many ninja there are in the main house. Can you come with me?
lg_Say_n81009: This letter records every move of the Akatsuki. I can't send it to Tsunade. Can you help me deliver this letter?
lg_Say_n81010: I'm worried about Asuma. Can you deliver a secret letter to Asuma for me?
lg_Say_n81011: If you wither before fully blooming... how unfortunate! A flower means nothing unless it blooms...
lg_Say_n81012: I'm badly hurt. I can still feel that Sasuke Uchiha is coming, but my life is in danger without a Medic Bag!
lg_Say_n81013: I was protected by others in the past... This time... it's my turn to protect them...
lg_Say_n81014: No one knows the loneliness and unease, no one knows the pain of living in a world without parents and friends....
lg_Say_n81015: Using a fan as a weapon is kind of boring. Kankuro's puppets seem interesting. I want a puppet of my own.
lg_Say_n81016: I only teamed up with you because you said you could make money. The least you can do is do something for me, the Akatsuki Treasurer.
lg_Say_n81017: Do you have someone who means a lot to you? For me, the most important thing is that one dream.
lg_Say_n81018: How fast these children grow up!
lg_Say_n81019: I never go back on my word! That's my ninja way!
lg_Say_n81020: You must protect this village, love the village and their trust.
lg_Say_n81021: Even if you kill me, you will still fail. I carry this title in trust for the First and Second Hokage! I am the Third Hokage!
lg_Say_n81022: Ninja exist to meet the need for protection
lg_Say_n81023: Now! Cower in awe! Scream in despair! For my art... is an EXPLOSION!
lg_Say_n81024: Too naive. A ninjutsu that focuses on shadows is boring.
lg_Say_n81025: You analyzed this by fighting only one. Good work.
lg_Say_n81026: Don't you dare say that word again!
lg_Say_n81027: A smile is the easiest way out of a difficult situation, even if it's a fake one.
lg_Say_n81028: This time... I hope you are a flower of hope that never dies.
lg_Say_n81029: Don't underestimate the little things in your life.
lg_Say_n81030: I want to show that I can be a beautiful ninja, even if I have no ninjutsu or genjutsu... I work hard and I never give up! This is my ninja way.
lg_Say_n81031: I need to improve my abilities by any means.
lg_Say_n81032: Sasuke Uchiha... Suigetsu Hozuki... wake up. Karin is on her way here. Hold on!
lg_Say_n81033: Don't use the same ninjutsu twice in front of me.
lg_Say_n81034: One day my little brother will come here. Please beat him with all your strength when that day comes. My brother can't beat you now. But growth happens when one exceeds one's limits. Realize that this is also part of training.
lg_Say_n81036: I am an avenger. I was born to take revenge. I can give up everything for revenge. Give me back Itachi, my parents and everyone in my clan! I'll stop my revenge if you give them back to me!!
lg_Say_n81037: To Itachi, I was more important than the village. And to me, he was also more important than the village.
lg_Say_n81038: You won't know how things will change until you do it. There's no use in speculation or persuasion. Show your loyalty.
lg_Say_n81039: But one day I will break that curse. If there is such a thing as peace, I will find it! Faith is better than any plan!
lg_Say_n81040: There is only one thing that matters if you are a shinobi, and it's not how many techniques you have. All you need is the courage to never give up.
lg_Say_n81041: Real things will vanish someday, but memories will not.
lg_Say_n81042: I will go to war against anyone to protect the village.
lg_Say_n81043: Don't accept fate if you don't like it!
lg_Say_n81044: The one who will change the world has not appeared yet. Who is the child conceived by the Great Toad Sage? I need to save my strength before I find this person.

lg_SlaveRescue_Explain: Defeat them to help your friend!
lg_SlaveTips_1:
My Disciples:

View current disciple info.
Arrange disciples to work in your house.
lg_SlaveTips_2:
Take disciples: You can capture the following people as disciples!
Opponents you defeat in the arena!
People who rob your disciples!
Your former owner!

If the capture target is a disciple, you need to defeat their owner to claim them as yours!
If the capture target is free, defeat them to capture them as a disciple!
If the capture target is a disciple's owner, defeat them and claim their disciple as yours!
lg_SlaveTips_3:
Rescue your friends:

These are your friends who have become disciples.
Click "Rescue" to fight their owner. Victory will guarantee their rescue!
lg_SlaveTips_4:
Pick plants from another house:
There is a certain risk in planting
If you find workers assigned to fight, you must defeat them to carry out the planting
If you lose the fight, you will become a disciple of that house's owner!!

You can choose a quick planting target from your house's friend list. Give it a try!
lg_SlaveTips_5:
Go to a designated player's house to harvest:

To get revenge on your enemy, enter the name above to harvest at their house!
lg_SlaveTips_6:
Current disciple status: you are currently a disciple.

You can take the following actions:
1. Resist: You have 1 chances each day to resist your owner. Only winning the battle guarantees your freedom.
2. Redemption: You can pay your owner an amount of gold to buy your freedom
3.. Help: If your owner treats you well, you can help them tidy their house .
lg_SlaveTips_9:
You can hire an NPC to help you capture disciples!
This function is not available.

lg_StartDialog_100: I am an Espada who can awaken. I'm sure you can feel the huge difference between our abilities. Kneel, human!
lg_StartDialog_110: If you are here, it means they are all dead. You must think of yourself as a strong human. But it ends here and now. I am Espada Cero, Yammy Llargo!
lg_StartDialog_120: Nothing can withstand the test of time, not even you! I am Baraggan Luisenbarn, Espada 2, King of Hueco Mundo!
lg_StartDialog_130: What a bother, now I can't play around anymore! I am Espada 1, Coyote Starrk!
lg_StartDialog_140: I am Espada No. 3, Tier Harribel. I will cut you in half with my sword! None of you can harm Lord Sosuke Aizen!
lg_StartDialog_150: Hoho, it is not good to get distracted during a fight. I am Gin Ichimaru, former captain of Division 3. Nice to meet you!
lg_StartDialog_151: Hoho, not too bad, but there is still a long road ahead!
lg_StartDialog_152: You are not too weak, that is all. You will not defeat me.
lg_StartDialog_153: You must have a strong conviction to succeed. But can you defeat me?
lg_StartDialog_154: Art does not come from violence but from peace. Be afraid of me.
lg_StartDialog_155: Life is so fragile in this world. What are you thinking?
lg_StartDialog_156: Every struggle is in vain when facing this sharp spear. How many times must I pierce your body with it?
lg_StartDialog_157: Nonviolence is the best form of warfare. You are qualified to be my rival, hahaha!
lg_StartDialog_158: Only the bravest can survive! If you can face death without blinking, you can win.
lg_StartDialog_159: Never start something, because I will always be the one to end it!
lg_StartDialog_160: You have proven your strength. But compared to my power, you are still... Well, can you withstand my attack?
lg_StartDialog_161: A strong body is what I want! Hssss.
lg_StartDialog_162: Can you understand the way of art? The secret of the imitation puppet!
lg_StartDialog_163: Life is the most important thing! Come here and prolong my life!
lg_StartDialog_164: Let me see all your blood! Pierce your body and receive my ritual!
lg_StartDialog_165: This is my art!!! Hahaha. I will cut your body into pieces!
lg_StartDialog_166: I want peace and an end to war !
lg_StartDialog_167: I have a question for you. What is your opinion of Sasuke Uchiha? What will you do to defeat him?
lg_StartDialog_168: Amazing! But my sword is not suited for killing!
lg_StartDialog_169: You have skill, but you have not yet felt true pain! If I were you, I would believe it!
lg_StartDialog_170: Only hatred can make you strong! You cannot change all of my hatred even if you have defeated me!
lg_StartDialog_20: I am Espada 9, Aaroniero Arruruerie. You must be human to be here to save Inoue. You will die by my sword!
lg_StartDialog_30: Hoho, you are finally here. I am Espada 6, Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez. I will show no mercy in your destruction; you are just waiting for your death!
lg_StartDialog_40: This is my true form. I will give you a swift and painless death with my panther claws!
lg_StartDialog_50: You are an intruder? Hoho, I am Espada 7, Rull Zommari. Marvel at my combat prowess!
lg_StartDialog_60: Hoho, you must be strong to have come this far into the monastery. But I have analyzed your combat ability. I am Espada 8, Szayel Aporro Granz!
lg_StartDialog_70: What a bunch of filth. I am Espada 5, Nnoitra Gilga. I am the strongest of the Espadas, and I am your executioner!
lg_StartDialog_80: Your achievements are strong enough to have brought you here. I am Espada 4, Ulquiorra Cifer. Since Lord Sosuke Aizen has given me a duty in Las Noches, I will make you fall where you stand!
lg_StartDialog_90: Are you strong enough? If not, you will not be able to save Inoue. I will end your journey right here!

lg_Tail_WhatIsWinCond:
In the defense against Tailed Beast attacks there are 9 tailed beasts and 9 villages. Each tailed beast attacks only one village.
To successfully protect a village, you must defeat the tailed beast before the village HP drops to 0.
In each defense against Tailed Beast attacks, you need to protect more than 5 villages to win.

lg_TaskDes_10001: After learning the basics of the ninja world, take the test from the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10002: The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>has recognized your right to join the guard squad. Find the<font color='#00b034'> Jounin </font>and report to him.
lg_TaskDes_10003: Go to the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>and reinforce the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>stationed there.
lg_TaskDes_10004: From the<font color='#00b034'> Stinger Bees</font>, obtain<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font> to save the travelers who were stung.
lg_TaskDes_10005: Having overcome the crisis, return to the village and report to the<font color='#00b034'> Jounin</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10006: Go to the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font> and find the<font color='#00b034'> Sushi </font>to get the Wasabi Sushi Roll needed for the banquet.
lg_TaskDes_10007: Tell the villagers to come to the<font color='#00b034'> hall </font>to join the celebration banquet.
lg_TaskDes_10008: The<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>are holding a meeting to find a way out of their difficulties. Go to the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>and find clues about where the<font color='#00b034'> Genin</font> are.
lg_TaskDes_10009: The<font color='#00b034'> Genin</font> was attacked by the<font color='#00b034'> Scarlet </font>gang. Wipe out the<font color='#00b034'> Scarlet </font>gang.
lg_TaskDes_10010: Find the ninja dog Pakkun who stole the<font color='#00b034'> Recon Scroll</font>.<font color='#00b034'></font>
lg_TaskDes_10011: The<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>found the<font color='#00b034'> Recon Scroll</font>. Give it to the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10012: After receiving news that the Demons plan to attack the village, the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>has decided to strike first.
lg_TaskDes_10013: Help the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>find the lost ninja dog Pakkun<font color='#00b034'></font>.
lg_TaskDes_10014: Defeat the demon who controls the shadows, the<font color='#00b034'> Warrior of Darkness</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10015: <font color='#00b034'>Pakkun </font>has discovered the true identity of the<font color='#00b034'> Warrior of Darkness</font>. Report this to the<font color='#00b034'> Genin</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10016: Report to the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>about the information on the<font color='#00b034'> Warrior of Darkness</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10017: Listen to what the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>says about the history of the<font color='#00b034'> Fire Village</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10018: Take part in the special training selection at<font color='#00b034'> Angel City</font>, and wipe out the<font color='#00b034'> Potatoes </font>that are destroying the village's crops.
lg_TaskDes_10019: It seems the<font color='#00b034'> Merchant Boss </font>has had an accident, see what you can do to help him.
lg_TaskDes_10020: The<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant </font>who was out shopping wholesale has not arrived in the village on the appointed date. Help the<font color='#00b034'> Merchant Boss </font>find the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10021: Help the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant </font>retrieve the goods stolen by the<font color='#00b034'> Monkey</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10022: Wipe out the<font color='#00b034'> Scarlet </font>gang at the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>and escort the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant </font>to the village.
lg_TaskDes_10023: The day to go to<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>is fast approaching. Report to the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>before you leave.
lg_TaskDes_10024: Help the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>gather materials to make<font color='#00b034'> Honeydew Riceballs</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10025: Deliver the<font color='#00b034'> Genin</font>'s greetings and a gift to<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan</font>.
lg_TaskDes_10026: Accept the test of<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan</font> and punish the<font color='#00b034'> Tree Ents </font>that disturb the peace of the village.
lg_TaskDes_10027: Go to the<font color='#00b034'> hall </font>in<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>and greet the<font color='#00b034'> Ninja Chief </font>.

lg_TaskDes_10061: Obtain the<font color='#00b034'> River God's Pearl </font>and exchange information with the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant</font>.

lg_TaskDes_10063: Go to<font color='#00b034'> Fiery Ridge </font>to investigate the fire seal.

lg_TaskDes_10067: Try out the effects of the<font color='#00b034'> Delicate Medicine </font>.

lg_TaskDes_10069: Destroy the<font color='#00b034'> Scorching Demon </font>that is bothering the village.
lg_TaskDes_10070: Accept the<font color='#00b034'> Ninja Chief</font>'s request and pursue the whereabouts of Ancient Ninja Island.
lg_TaskDes_10071: Help<font color='#00b034'> Kabuki </font>and destroy the demons beside<font color='#00b034'> Sun Village </font>, the<font color='#00b034'> Rogue Shaman</font>.

lg_TaskDes_10080: Be approved by the<font color='#00b034'> Ninja Chief </font>and<font color='#00b034'> Master Yuan </font>, and become a member of the special forces.

lg_TaskDes_10082: Punish the<font color='#00b034'> Demon Flute Succubus </font>who lures tourists.
lg_TaskDes_10083: Go to<font color='#00b034'> Glowing Forest </font>to help the troubled<font color='#00b034'> Craftsman </font>.
lg_TaskDes_10084: The<font color='#00b034'> Craftsman </font>was attacked by the<font color='#00b034'> Bald Eagle </font>. Kill it.

lg_TaskDes_10088: <font color='#00b034'> Sun Village </font>is being harassed by the<font color='#00b034'> Sunrise Brigand </font>. Defeat them.

lg_TaskDes_50001:
Enter Leveling to see the events in the game.

Tips: Enter the Fire Village and look at the quick tips on the right, then click the [Leveling] icon to open the leveling guide view and see the daily events you can join.
lg_TaskDes_50002:
Go from the world map to the outer zone.

Tips: Click the [world map] icon at the top right of the game view to open the world map interface, then find and click the Smelting Mountains area to go to the Smelting Mountains.
lg_TaskDes_50003:
Explore in the Smelting Mountains Exploration Zone.

Tips: In the Smelting Mountains zone, look for the sparkling Smelting Mountains Exploration Zone, and click it to open the exploration view. Then select the [Click to explore a little] icon in the view to explore.
lg_TaskDes_50004: Click the<font color='#00b034'> Player Info </font>area at the top left of the game view, then to the right of the<font color='#00b034'> HP/Chakra Panel</font>, the [<font color='#00b034'>pouch</font>] icon, open the<font color='#00b034'> pouch </font>view and choose how much<font color='#00b034'> HP/Chakra </font>to refill the<font color='#00b034'> pouch capacity </font>with.
lg_TaskDes_50005: <font color='#00b034'>Explore </font>and raise the completion rate of the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains Exploration Zone </font>to<font color='#00b034'> 100%</font>, successfully reaching the<font color='#00b034'> Star 1 </font>exploration level.
lg_TaskDes_50006:
Go to the Smelting Mountains zone view, monster list, pick a normal monster and perform a Combo once.
Tips: Enter the Smelting Mountains, pick an entry from the monster list of the normal monster type and attack. In the monster menu, select [Combo] to open the Combo view. In that view, choose how many times you want to Combo, then click [OK] to start the Combo.
lg_TaskDes_50007:
Through exploration, get a Demon Proof of Suppression, then defeat the Smelting Mountains demon boss Demon Brute.

Tips: In the Smelting Mountains Exploration zone, do an exploration to get a Demon Proof of Suppression, wait for the Smelting Mountains Demon Brute to appear and defeat it. Demon Brute appears at a set time every hourin the Smelting Mountains. It stays for 40 min before leaving, then appears again at the next scheduled time.
lg_TaskDes_50008:
Quickly finish a Combo in progress.

Tips: Click a monster in the Monster List to show the action menu, then click Attack/Combo to open the current Combo info, and click [Finish Now] to finish the Combo currently in progress.
lg_TaskDes_50009:
Claim a quest reward.

Tips: Go to the Fire Village or Angel City, enter the quest reward area and talk to Rewards to open the Claim Quest Reward view. Then, from your current quest rewards, pick a quest and click [Claim the Reward] in the quest details zone to receive the quest reward of your choice.
lg_TaskDes_50010: Go to<font color='#00b034'> Demon City </font>and talk to the<font color='#00b034'> Demon City Guard </font>to investigate the trail of the<font color='#00b034'> Decadent Ninja</font>.
lg_TaskDes_50011:
Add a friend.
1. Click to open the guide button friends view. 2. Click the add friend icon, and enter the friend name you want to add.
lg_TaskDes_50012:
In the game, the Item Mall sells items.

Tips: Click [ Item Mall ] on the guide bar to open the interface, then browse and buy some items.
In the Mall,many items can be bought with Gold or Gift Coupon, while some items can only be bought with Gold.
lg_TaskDes_50013:
Click the jar icon at the top right, enter the jar shop and smash the jar 10 times.

Tips: Use Honor or Gold to smash more. You can earn Honor from Arena challengesor by accumulating quest reward points; you can also use [Multiple] for jar smashing.

lg_TaskDes_59505:
On every piece of equipment that has slots , do socketing .

Tips: Open your bag , and drag any crystal from your bag onto a piece of equipment that already has slots , click Slot , and the crystal you chose will be socketed into the equipment , with the equipment tooltip showing the slot's crystal attributes .

Tips: Open your bag , and on the right of the bag , click the [Quick Synthesis] icon to open the Synthesis view. Drag 3 outfit pieces from the talented Forge Boss into the main item and catalyst slots, then click Start Synthesis to start combining .

To keep Ieyasu from scheming to escape from Demon City and spread chaos again, the Ninja Chief founded Angel City and 5 major ninja villages, then sent 5 disciples to become the head of each village, to protect Angel City and to keep Ieyasu sealed.
We, the Fire Village are one of the 5 greatest ninja villages, supporting the seal with the Guard Squad and sending elite ninja to Angel City .

lg_TaskTalk940011: Are you happy with it? Not everyone gets a gift from me ^_^!
lg_TaskTalk940020: Choosing the right weapon is important for a ninja! Now pick and equip <font color='#00b034'>your favorite weapon</font>. I'm sure you can find the right one.
lg_TaskTalk940021: Awesome! This weapon suits you. I can feel it.
lg_TaskTalk940030: The <font color='#00b034'>Quest Panel</font> is <font color='#00b034'>the button at the top right of your screen</font>. Click the <font color='#00b034'>Magnifying Glass</font> to check quest details. Click the <font color='#00b034'>Teleport Arrow</font> to go straight to a quest and report it. This will help you complete quests faster.
lg_TaskTalk940031: Now it's time for combat training! Go to the <font color='#00b034'>Hidden Dragon Corridor</font> and talk to the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font>. He will arrange your training. Do your best!
lg_TaskTalk940040: A sunny day. First, you need to know how to fight. There is a creature called a <font color='#ff0000'>Sunflower</font>. Go and kill it. I will check your work!
lg_TaskTalk940041: Mmmm! For a beginner, you're not bad. I've waited a long time for a talent like you. Keep doing your best! Now return to the Village. The Village Elder will give you your next instructions.
lg_TaskTalk940050: I heard what happened at Hidden Dragon Corridor. Good for you! I will guide you through the next fight. It's in the same place. There are some mutant bees in the <font color='#00b034'>Hidden Dragon Corridor</font>――the <font color='#ff0000'>Stinger Bees</font>! Kill them all to prove you're capable!!
lg_TaskTalk940051: Awesome! You passed the training! Now I can trust you to complete tasks. You'd better go to the <font color='#00b034'>Hidden Dragon Corridor</font>, meet the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font> and thank him for his help. Maybe he has some new quests for you!
lg_TaskTalk940060: Oh, it's you! I hope you can help me... The number of pesky <font color='#ff0000'>Stinger Bees</font> has increased. Can you wipe them out for me? Even killing one would help.
lg_TaskTalk940061: Yes, keep up the good work. The Genin needs your help with another problem. Bon voyage!
lg_TaskTalk940070: You're just in time! The <font color='#ff0000'>Sunflowers</font> are starting to become a nuisance. You must wipe them out to settle it! It's not a heavy job, but never underestimate your enemy.
lg_TaskTalk940071: Smart student! You've completed it. Here is your reward! It will help you in the future.
lg_TaskTalk940080: The <font color='#ff0000'>Healing Pouch</font> is quite helpful. You can use it when you want supplies in the wilds.
lg_TaskTalk940081: How do you feel? Your energy is full again, isn't it?
lg_TaskTalk940090: Don't celebrate yet. Now I need detailed information about the <font color='#00b034'>Hidden Dragon Corridor</font>, which has been recorded by the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font>. All you need to do is bring those notes back.
lg_TaskTalk940091: I have information on this, but I have to organize it first.
lg_TaskTalk940100: The information you need is very simple. But I will arrange your memory notes so that you can't take this information with you. Do you remember it all? If so, you may go now.
lg_TaskTalk940101: Judging by what you just told me, the situation there isn't bad. But still, we can't lower our guard!
lg_TaskTalk940110: The next mission is to find something for my research into a new formula. Meet the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font> at the <font color='#00b034'>Hidden Dragon Corridor</font> to learn about all that. You can meet him for the full details.
lg_TaskTalk940111: I need to think about it carefully. You can rest now.
lg_TaskTalk940120: I think the Village Elder wants <font color='#00b034'>Wasabi Sushi Rolls</font>. You won't find them around here because they're very rare. You must defeat the <font color='#ff0000'>Sushi</font> first. Be careful, they're good at running away. Return to the Village Elder when the search is over.
lg_TaskTalk940121: Yup, this is it. This is very helpful for my research! You look tired, so rest first.
lg_TaskTalk940130: As for the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font>, I'm stuck at work right now. Can you tell him I'll arrange for someone else to take over this case?
lg_TaskTalk940131: The Village Elder is always thinking of us. We must do everything to show our skills and try to be the best ninja we can.
lg_TaskTalk940140: Please tell the Village Elder not to worry, because guarding the border is my duty. I believe he thinks so too, doesn't he?
lg_TaskTalk940141: I'm so glad our village has a ninja like you. Here's another reward for you!!
lg_TaskTalk940150: Please open the <font color='#00b034'>Newbie Quest Pack</font>. It's all I have to give you. You can find what you want inside.
lg_TaskTalk940151: The key to success is hard work. I hope you can remember that, kid. Never give in to anyone!

lg_changeAdvanced_0010:
1. Drag a Costume +1 or higher from your bag into the box (to receive a special outfit).
2. Click to start. The system will transfer the original Costume to another one with the same grade, level, and bound attributes.
3. The original transfer may fail and the Costume may be lost. You can use a Protection Talisman to keep the original Costume.
4. You can pay more Gold to guarantee a 100% success rate.

You have undergone special training, so these bats could be good practice for you.
